root_cause: After the pricing build parse fix merged to main, Production Release Readback started but Production Source Snapshot did not because the snapshot workflow itself had not changed. A controlled operational refresh marker is required to invoke the canonical snapshot/deploy workflow on the corrected main SHA.
prevention: After any production-blocking build fix merges, verify that Production Source Snapshot actually ran for that exact merge SHA; readback alone is not sufficient.
If snapshot did not run, use one controlled operational refresh of the canonical workflow, not an alternate deploy path.
Keep application code unchanged during snapshot-only recovery.
LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires provider success, exact release.json SHA/context/deploy-id and production browser readback.
